observations: Blue industrial cooling radiator mounted on a wooden pallet.

The unit is positioned next to a green industrial machine.

risks.proof: A photo of the manufacturer's label or technical specification plate on the unit.

risks.risk: The cooling fins may be severely rusted or damaged.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the underside of the radiator fins.

risks.risk: The fan motor may be seized or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the fan blades spinning.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the underside of the radiator fins to check for rust.
Video of the fan motor running.
Photo of the technical specification plate.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
